label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, mono stats, nav data.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for light-surface cards (testimonial strip chips).

shadows.name: nav-compact
shadows.purpose: Applied once the sticky nav scrolls past 48px and compacts.

shadows.name: ticket-rest
shadows.purpose: Featured Challenges ticket cards at rest.

shadows.name: ticket-hover
shadows.purpose: Featured Challenges ticket cards on hover, paired with translateY(-4px).

shadows.name: testimonial-spotlight
shadows.purpose: The dark promoted-quote card in the testimonials section.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: The challenge-brief and ticket modals — the heaviest shadow on the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition and animation on the page.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: The universal button hover/focus feedback, used instead of a shadow change.

motion.name: mode-swap
motion.purpose: Crossfade used by audience-mode-aware copy blocks when the toggle switches.

motion.name: fluid-scrub-pan
motion.purpose: How-it-works' pinned background pan — compositor-only, not background-position, so it never repaints per scroll frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled pill button, the default CTA style; hovers to Signal orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:13px 24px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#14130f; color:#fff; font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ff5b24; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #14130f; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Filled with the active audience accent (Signal or Current); hovers to that accent's deep variant.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:13px 24px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#ff5b24; color:#fff; font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background:#c73e10; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #14130f; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent outline button for secondary actions on light backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:13px 24px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #e6e3da; background:transparent; color:#14130f; font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#14130f; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #14130f; }

components.description: Dark promoted-quote card; hovering or focusing a chip in the strip below swaps which quote is spotlighted here. The speaker tag is pinned blue (company) or orange (builder) regardless of audience mode — it labels who's speaking, not who's browsing.

components.css: .ds-ch-ticket { display:flex; width:340px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #e6e3da; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 14px 30px -26px rgba(20,19,15,.3); font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), box-shadow .22s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-ch-ticket:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 26px 48px -28px rgba(20,19,15,.38); } .ds-ch-body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; flex:1; padding:22px; } .ds-ch-co { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#726d5f; } .ds-ch-title { margin:0; font-size:17.5px; font-weight:800; } .ds-ch-desc { font-size:12.5px; color:#3a382f; line-height:1.5; } .ds-ch-subs { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:#726d5f; } .ds-ch-view { align-self:flex-start; margin-top:auto; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid #e6e3da; background:transparent; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ch-perf { width:0; border-left:2px dashed #e6e3da; margin:14px 0; } .ds-ch-stub { width:76px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:16px 6px; } .ds-ch-num { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:26px; font-weight:700; color:#c73e10; } .ds-ch-unit { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#726d5f; text-align:center; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Pill-shaped text input; border shifts to the active accent on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { flex:1; min-width:0; padding:10px 13px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #e6e3da; background:#fff; font-size:13.5px; color:#14130f; font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; transition:border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#ff5b24; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small mono pill tagging status or category, tinted by accent side.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:4px 9px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(47,107,255,.12); color:#1d4fd6; }

components.name: Skip Link
components.description: Off-screen until keyboard focus, then drops in as a pill button above the sticky nav.

components.name: Pending Link
components.description: A destination that doesn't exist yet: named and marked "soon" rather than linked to nowhere. The site's honesty convention, shared with the front-end-only forms.
components.css: .ds-footer-pending { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif; font-size:14px; color:#726d5f; padding:6px 0; cursor:default; } .ds-footer-pending em { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-style:normal; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:#e6e3da; color:#726d5f; }

components.name: Audience Mode Toggle
components.description: Signature component: a pill-track toggle with a sliding, color-shifting indicator behind whichever audience option is active.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { position:relative; display:inline-flex; padding:3px; gap:2px; background:#f5f4ef; border:1px solid #e6e3da; border-radius:999px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-mode-indicator { position:absolute; top:3px; left:3px; width:calc(50% - 3px); height:calc(100% - 6px); border-radius:999px; background:#ff5b24; z-index:0; transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), background .32s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-mode-opt { position:relative; z-index:1; padding:7px 15px; border-radius:999px; border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.03em; color:#3a382f; transition:color .22s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-mode-opt.is-active { color:#fff; }

narrative.overview:
Projet's whole surface is built around one idea: a single warm accent burning against a calm, mostly-neutral field, and that flare only ever means one thing — real activity, happening right now. The countdown ticking down to a challenge deadline, the recycling logo marquee, the Featured Challenges ticket rail a visitor can drag through like a real feed of open work, the How-it-works panel that pins in place and scrubs through its own background as you scroll, the testimonial spotlight promoting a different quote the instant you hover its chip — none of it is ambient decoration. Every moving element on the page is standing in for the same claim the copy makes in words: that proof is live and ongoing, not a static portfolio.

The system carries a second, cooler signal alongside the first: builders and students read the page in Signal orange, companies read it in Current blue, and the accent color itself is the audience switch. This is not two different designs pretending to be one — it's one calm, confident-startup shell (bold black-on-white type, real stated numbers, no soft SaaS gradients or stock illustration standing in for substance) that relabels its own accent depending on who's looking. Headline text itself stays a flat, solid accent color rather than a gradient (a gradient-text word was tried and removed as a recognisable AI-generated-site tell); the audience switch shows up in flat color, not a rainbow bridge.

Density is generous, not dense — this is a persuade-mode marketing surface, not a dashboard, and it gives its stats, cards, and CTAs room to breathe. Nothing renders in hard corners, and nothing sits completely still without a reason: every interactive control confirms itself with a lift, a color shift, or a sliding glyph the instant it's touched.
keyCharacteristics: One accent lit against a mostly-neutral (ink/paper) field, never two accents competing for attention on the same surface
The accent itself carries meaning — it names which audience is currently being addressed
Motion is evidentiary, not decorative: it always stands in for "this is live, this is real work happening now"
Confident, plainly-stated startup tone: bold headlines, real numbers, no hedge-everything softness
Every interactive element visibly responds to hover/focus — nothing is static once touched

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only Signal or Current is active as the page's accent at any moment — never both, and a surface never lets orange and blue compete as two live CTAs. The one deliberate exception is the testimonial spotlight's speaker tag, which is pinned to blue for a company speaker or orange for a builder speaker regardless of audience mode, because its job is to label who is speaking, not to reflect who's currently browsing.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Any small-caps or label-scale text — eyebrows, badges, nav toggle labels, stat captions, countdown digits — is always set in JetBrains Mono, never Satoshi.

rules.name: The Motion-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Buttons never change shadow on hover — they lift (translateY(-2px)) instead. Shadow answers "is this surface floating above another," motion answers "did you just interact with this."

rules.name: The No-Hard-Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the system ships a 0px corner. The only question is how generous the round is, never whether to round at all.

dos: Do let the accent color (--accent) name the audience — never hardcode Signal or Current onto a control that should track the current mode.
Do pair every hover/focus state with visible motion (lift, underline sweep, fill-color swap) — a static default-only control reads as dead.
Do round every corner — pill for controls, 13–28px for containers, scaled to size.
Do set any label-scale text (eyebrows, badges, stats, captions) in JetBrains Mono, uppercase, wide tracking.
Do treat scroll-linked and hover-driven motion as enhancement only — every effect must render its end state under prefers-reduced-motion or with JavaScript disabled, never disappear.
donts: Don't run Signal and Current as two live, competing CTAs on the same surface outside the testimonial spotlight's speaker tag.
Don't apply a shadow change as a button's hover feedback — use the translateY(-2px) lift instead.
Don't revert Muted Label to a lighter value than #726d5f (or Muted Label Large below #8f8874) — both were darkened specifically to clear WCAG AA at the small sizes they're used at.
Don't apply the base Signal or Current hue directly to small text (eyebrows, labels) — use Signal Deep / Current Deep instead; the base hues fail WCAG AA at those sizes.
Don't introduce a third accent hue. Spectrum Violet exists only as a gradient midpoint, never as a control fill.
